pr_title: Fixed ONNX Range layer to support any input type
pr_body:
Fixed ONNX Range layer to support any input type

Extra PR: https://github.com/opencv/opencv_extra/pull/1173
Fixes #25363 

### Pull Request Readiness Checklist

See details at https://github.com/opencv/opencv/wiki/How_to_contribute#making-a-good-pull-request

- [x] I agree to contribute to the project under Apache 2 License.
- [x] To the best of my knowledge, the proposed patch is not based on a code under GPL or another license that is incompatible with OpenCV
- [x] The PR is proposed to the proper branch
- [x] There is a reference to the original bug report and related work
- [x] There is accuracy test, performance test and test data in opencv_extra repository, if applicable
      Patch to opencv_extra has the same branch name.
- [x] The feature is well documented and sample code can be built with the project CMake

### Detailed description

I try to read [yolov9](https://huggingface.co/Xenova/yolov9-onnx/blob/main/yolov9-c.onnx)

then simplify model

`onnxsim \yolov9-c.onnx a.sim.onnx`
![image](https://github.com/opencv/opencv/assets/3591626/96261274-7fac-485a-8f0e-527ffa96611f)

then I fixed batch size

```
python -m onnxruntime.tools.make_dynamic_shape_fixed --dim_param batch --dim_value 1 a.sim.onnx a1.onnx
python -m onnxruntime.tools.make_dynamic_shape_fixed --dim_param width --dim_value 640 a1.onnx a2.onnx
python -m onnxruntime.tools.make_dynamic_shape_fixed --dim_param height --dim_value 480 a2.onnx a3.onnx
```



### Steps to reproduce

```
import cv2 as cv
x = cv.dnn.readNet("a3.onnx")

```
Error

```
[ERROR:0@12.081] global onnx_importer.cpp:1047 cv::dnn::dnn5_v20231225::ONNXImporter::handleNode DNN/ONNX: ERROR during processing node with 3 inputs and 1 outputs: [Range]:(onnx_node!/model.38/Range) from domain='ai.onnx'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
cv2.error: OpenCV(5.0.0-pre) C:\lib\opencv\modules\dnn\src\onnx\onnx_importer.cpp:1066: error: (-2:Unspecified error) in function 'cv::dnn::dnn5_v20231225::ONNXImporter::handleNode'
> Node [Range@ai.onnx]:(onnx_node!/model.38/Range) parse error: OpenCV(5.0.0-pre) C:\lib\opencv\modules\dnn\src\onnx\onnx_importer.cpp:610: error: (-17:Input image depth is not supported by function) blob should have integer type in function 'cv::dnn::dnn5_v20231225::ONNXImporter::getIntBlob'

```
